question: Would per-action evidence dependencies prevent false course-publication admission without blocking unrelated work more effectively than existing review flags and source-SHA checks?
production_path: baseline: inspect the pinned Demerzel advisory lane selector and its mode-blocked work classes
graph: draw action-to-receipt prerequisites and keep independent task paths separate
candidate: sketch a pure conjunction of scoped, revision-bound receipt checks
counterargument: compare against simple review and publish flags plus the Learn source guard
falsifier: predeclare false-admission, unnecessary-block, decision-time, and explanation outcomes
hypothesis: A per-action receipt graph might admit independent work while deferring publication when a required same-revision review is absent, but should be rejected if simple existing flags give equal or better decisions with less cost.
evidence: At Demerzel commit ecdc6c27559bb1a11343cfad33687465893e9891, scripts/aiw_lane_selector.py and state/driver/aiw-worker-lanes.json implement advisory role and mode gating, including SYSTEM.BACKPRESSURE_HIGH for blocked work classes. They do not inspect Streeling review receipts or Learn source provenance.

At Demerzel commit 29e83e08120cba99452020c54c31680c28b32c3e, the NET-003 production record has review.completed=false and publish.completed=false. Its local selector replay receipt is a bounded dry-run experiment, not a human subject or learner verdict.

The merged Learn clean-source guard at commit 3f4de745f56e81f237159997473253546d7f6d64 rejects an uncommitted Streeling source checkout that would otherwise be imported under a misleading HEAD SHA. It checks provenance, not pedagogical approval.

Five answered synthetic and project-transfer exercises state explicit outcomes and a rejection criterion for proposed semantic evidence dependencies. Independent AI adversarial review identified an incorrect one-edge graph-cut interpretation, a circular learner gate, and an overstated method; the draft was revised. No semantic-backpressure DSL, runtime comparison, learner result, human approval, or publication was performed. Research duration was not instrumented, so duration_seconds=0.
